top_paper.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
top_paper.summary: OmniCompass is a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding that evaluates vision-language and audio-visual reasoning through temporal grounding, spatial grounding, and question answering tasks.

papers.title: ANTE: Anticipate, Then Execute -- Learning Internal World Models for Coding Agents from Verified Beliefs
papers.summary: ANTE is a reinforcement learning framework that uses pre-action predictions verified by execution to provide per-step credit and improve coding agent decisions, significantly boosting benchmark performance.

papers.title: RepForcing: Representation-Space Initialization for Autoregressive Video Distillation
papers.summary: Representation Forcing improves few-step video generation by using feature-space supervision instead of trajectory regression, boosting quality metrics over causal ODE baselines.

papers.title: Memory as Weights: Internalizing Long-Term History for Streaming Videos
papers.summary: MaLoW internalizes streaming video history into evolving LoRA weights via a recurrent HyperNetwork, improving streaming vision-language performance with minimal latency overhead.

papers.title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft
papers.summary: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. papers.title: Athanor: An Agent-Native System for Autonomous Post-Training Research
papers.summary: A team of autonomous AI agents used an open research system to independently post-train a small base model into a cross-domain generalist that matched or exceeded its official instruction-tuned version.

papers.title: Do Better Visual Representations Always Lead to Better End-to-End Autonomous Driving?
papers.summary: ViRA aligns visual foundation model representations with end-to-end driving planners to improve performance, showing that target selection and auxiliary perception supervision significantly affect planning gains.

papers.title: SimVTA: Simulation-Grounded Video-Trajectory Alignment for Driving World Action Models
papers.summary: SimVTA improves driving world action models by combining simulator-rendered video supervision with reinforcement learning trajectory optimization.

papers.title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
papers.summary: 3DCodeVerse is a research ecosystem that provides datasets, automated verification harnesses, and empirical guidance to enable scalable, editable, and verifiable 3D content generation via executable code.

papers.title: EdgeWise: Bringing Long-Horizon Agents to the Edge via Selective Cloud Delegation
papers.summary: EdgeWise uses a local small language model with selective cloud delegation via reinforcement learning to reduce inference costs on long-horizon agent tasks without sacrificing performance.

papers.title: TimeRSI: Towards Self-Improved Agentic Deployment for Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.summary: TimeRSI is an agentic system that iteratively improves forecasting pipelines via error-guided code revisions and adaptive selection, boosting zero-shot time-series performance without altering frozen models.

papers.title: Intern-Decision: Efficient Multimodal Decision Making with Autoregressive Masked Language Modeling
papers.summary: Intern-Decision introduces compact multimodal models that output structured choices with probabilities via masked language modeling, achieving high accuracy and low latency for interactive agents.

papers.title: Terminal-RSI: Recursive Self-Improving Terminal Agents via Recursive Self-Rewrite and Policy-Refine
papers.summary: Terminal-RSI alternates recursive trajectory rewriting with critic-inheriting policy refinement to advance terminal agents from partial progress to strict verification.

papers.title: SCOPE: Semantic Bounded Credit Optimization for Prompt Engineering in Text-to-image Generation
papers.summary: SCOPE improves text-to-image prompt rewriting via reinforcement learning by aligning policy updates with semantic spans, boosting generation quality without extra rendering.

papers.title: Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World?
papers.summary: Orbia introduces a benchmark that systematically evaluates 3D consistency in interactive video world models through controlled exploration, revisit protocols, and multi-dimensional measurements of input preservation, content persistence, and geometric self-consistency.

papers.title: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.summary: AutoSFT uses multi-agent collaboration to automate diverse supervised fine-tuning data actions, improving evaluation scores over single-agent systems by separating execution, analysis, and synthesis.

papers.title: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.summary: Speculative Forcing accelerates few-step autoregressive video generation by accepting early token drafts and skipping unnecessary denoising steps while preserving output quality.

papers.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
papers.summary: OmniCompass is a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding that evaluates vision-language and audio-visual reasoning through temporal grounding, spatial grounding, and question answering tasks.

papers.title: MFVSR: A Multi-Style and Fine-Grained Benchmark for Video Subtitle Removal
papers.summary: MFVSR introduces a large-scale, multi-style benchmark for video subtitle removal that evaluates restoration fidelity, preservation, temporal consistency, and reliability through fine-grained, spatially decoupled protocols.

papers.title: Calibrated Typed Decisions for Entity, Relation, and Event Extraction
papers.summary: CalOn is a compact unified encoder that jointly performs entity, relation, and event extraction across diverse schemas by encoding text with type definitions and using shared probabilistic reasoning over combined type evidence.

papers.title: JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs
papers.summary: A harness that delegates agent tool choices to small decision models via fitted confidence thresholds reduces cost and latency while preserving task success, supported by a new benchmark and a 4B model trained on agent error states.

papers.title: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
papers.summary: PN-Mix improves low-bit KV cache quantization by identifying salient RoPE channel pairs via query-key norms, achieving strong accuracy at lower bit rates.

papers.title: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
papers.summary: Intern Lumina U2 is a diffusion language model that uses multi-codebook discrete visual tokens to unify image, video, and 3D generation with text in a single backbone, achieving high performance and faster inference.

papers.title: SWE-at-Scale: Scalable Issue Synthesis from Historical Bug Fixes
papers.summary: SWE-at-Scale synthesizes realistic software engineering tasks by inverting real-world fixes to generate diverse, executable bugs for evaluating coding agents.

papers.title: CoTranslator: Reverse to Forward Chain-of-Thought Translator for Reasoning Distillation
papers.summary: CoTranslator translates reverse reasoning traces to match verified forward reasoning distributions, enabling efficient and transferable reasoning distillation for student models.

papers.title: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation
papers.summary: Speculative Sampling enables interactive video generation with large bidirectional windows by caching predictions and delivering them incrementally, reducing latency without sacrificing quality.

papers.title: FreeSolo: Linear-time Sparse Attention with Zero-Shot Length Extrapolation
papers.summary: FreeSolo introduces a native sparse attention mechanism with short-range and long-range branches that achieves linear-time complexity and improves zero-shot length extrapolation without costly long-context fine-tuning.

papers.title: Unlocking Structured Pruning for Reasoning Language Models via Attention-Preserving MLP Trimming
papers.summary: LayerTrim is a training-free structured pruning approach that removes redundant decoder layers and trims MLP features to preserve reasoning ability, reducing inference costs and generation length.

papers.title: Lluna: Collaborative Unimodal Models for Missing-Modality Inference
papers.summary: Lluna improves multimodal predictions under missing inputs by combining private unimodal predictions with graph-based residual collaboration and progressive consistency training.

papers.title: Looking Complete Is Not Being Grounded: Evaluating LLM Sitreps Against Human-Authored Situation Reports
papers.summary: LLM-generated crisis reports match human performance on some metrics but fail to supply professional provenance and reproduce few official figures, while common automatic scores poorly reflect completeness.

papers.title: When Left Is Right? Camera-Motion Understanding beyond Screen
papers.summary: CameraVLM improves vision-language model understanding of camera motion by jointly learning off-screen motion states and on-screen flow dynamics with language-aligned training.
